verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is a first-party serverless framework that automatically runs backend code in response to background events, HTTPS requests, Admin SDK calls, or Cloud Scheduler jobs. Documented trigger sources include Firebase Authentication and Cloud Storage events. These are code-defined event triggers rather than declarative rules. Security Rules govern data access only and do not trigger actions. Missing for 10: a declarative/no-code rule-definition interface, evidence of AI-native (e.g., MCP or Gemini) authoring of event triggers, and independent hands-on corroboration of trigger depth.
